name: Educomp Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Educomp Solutions Ltd is in the business of providing education and other related services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ECSL is engaged in providing end-to-end solutions in the education technology domain through licensing of digital content, solutions 
for bridging the digital divide (a government initiative to enhance computer literacy), professional development and retail & consulting initiatives. The company’s business can be categorized into 4 strategic business units namely:
a) School Learning Solutions comprising Smart Class & Edureach (ICT) business
b) K-12 Schools comprising preschools & high schools.
c) Higher Learning Solutions comprising vocational, higher education and professional 
development.
d) Online, Supplemental & Global business comprising internet based education
 services and coaching.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 94.4% of their holding.
Company has high debtors of 10,773 days.
